items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 29, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: But I do a bit by Lenny Bruce that Lenny did with Steve Allen.

ctx.x: You know. I just cut a record for HighNote again. I’m happy to be with them. And it’s all very esoteric music. Babs Gonsales, an Elvis Costello tune — that’s not esoteric but for me to include Elvis Costello’s music what I do to me is a stretch. But I do a bit by Lenny Bruce that Lenny did with Steve Allen. It’s not dated. It’s so today. So that kind of stuff, I mean I want to be turned on to something different. So I hope that somebody who comes to see what I do wants to get turned on to something different.…
Hat size. I’ve got to borrow that one too. That’s great. So I know you have to get on the road. Do you have a piece of advice for aspiring singers? What should they always have?

items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, November 11, 2017 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: performing headliners, one was Sarah Vaughan and one was Steve Allen.

ctx.x: Well when I went up there I was going to stay for a year and a year started to go by and I liked living up there. I left one year and went to work in Washington State in construction. I got to sit in a little bit in a couple of places in Olympia and Seattle. I went back to Alaska. I went to Arizona for a season and worked on a road job. Went back to Alaska. Came back to the East Coast for about eight or nine months, went back to Alaska. There was something about it. I mean there’s two things that’ll happen to you…

performing headliners, one was Sarah Vaughan and one was Steve Allen. Yeah. I said wow. And it was a two week festival. And it wasn’t just performances. It was workshops that you could attend. And these workshops were from square dancing to photography to charcoal drawing to classical violin, singing, dancing, you name it. Arts festival. And they had to two week cabaret class. Not my thing but the instructor was a woman by the name of Chris Calloway. Cab’s daughter. Well that was enough for me to sign up. Cab…

people who really could play, as opposed to people who couldn’t play that good. That’s who I was usually playing with. And it felt good. And I thought you know I’m getting kind of tired of bouncing around on a piece of equipment, maybe I’ll go back to the East Coast. I’ll go to New York City and I’ll see if I can make a little noise. Because these people encouraged me. And in my mind, and I’ve said this to a few people and I’m going to say it again although I don’t have rehearsed lines, but I knew that — I went…
